dct_description_sm: Most maps earlier than 1800 in this collection are photocopies or facsimiles.
Since 1896, the New York City borough of Brooklyn has had the same boundaries as Kings County.

This record covers single maps covering counties of New York, which are not represented in the LC database by separate catalog records. This collection includes single printed maps and photocopies of printed or manuscript single maps and may also include some multi-sheet single maps, plates from atlases, books or periodicals, and printed facsimiles. These maps may also show various subjects, such as roads, topography, geology, hydrology, and recreation and tourism. To request a specific map or for more information, contact a reference librarian in the Geography & Map Division (202) 707-6277 or through the "Ask a librarian" link through the Geography & Map Division website https://ask.loc.gov/map-geography/.
